label: preparing
what: Likely coordinated preparation of a community bread meal/gathering in the great hall at day 1, 18:00, with some arrangements kept private from the mayor. Innkeeper, builder and Freight are explicitly reported coordinating arrangements. Neighbour admits keeping an earlier conversation private as requested and agrees to welcome the arriving guest and leave things ready. Baker may have supplied bread or lighting, but the lantern transfer alone does not establish knowing participation in concealed preparations. Secretary knowingly scheduled and relayed arrival instructions, but knowledge of concealment is not established. Mayor was eventually told about the community meal; evidence supports private particulars, not that the entire event remained unknown or that it was definitely a surprise celebration.
